## Harness

<!-- d10e: auto-prune -->
<!-- Copier-vendored from the agentic-engineering-template — do NOT edit
     here; change it in the template and pull via `copier update`. The
     auto-prune marker above lets `disambiguate prune` remove this term
     from a repo that never links it. -->

An environment that harnesses the _energy_ of a [model](large-language-model.md). A
**harness** such as Claude Code, Hermes or Codex gives the model tools,
files and a working environment. Some harnesses can also start the
model through a webhook when an event occurs, such as a pull request
opened on the forge.
